{{Quote|The setback at Felucia has affected our efforts in the whole sector.|Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="Holocron Heist">{{TCW|Holocron Heist}}</ref>}}
The '''Thanium Worlds''' was a historical region of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that was located on the west of the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]]. Later on, the region became a [[Sector/Legends|sector]], known alternatively as the '''Thanium sector'''. Notable historic Thanium Worlds included [[Thanium]], [[Ranroon]] and [[Yutusk]].

==History==
[[File:Thanium_Worlds.jpg|thumb|left|220px|The Thanium sector and its surrounding [[Sector/Legends|sectors]]]]
Originally, the Thanium Worlds were a region independent from the Tion Cluster or the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]], with an extent relatively similar to the modern Thanium sector.<ref name="EAOC" />

The Thanium Worlds were conquered by [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot]] between [[25,126 BBY]] and [[25,116 BBY]].<ref name="Atlas" /> He significantly enlarged the region and made it the industrial engine of his [[Xim's empire|empire]]. At its greatest extent, it stretched from the Tion Cluster to the edges of the [[Radama Void/Legends|Radama Void]], including parts of the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] and the future [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Worlds]].<ref name="EAOC" />

After the death of Xim, his empire fragmented and the Thanium Worlds became independent again. Contrary to the other feuding states that rose from the ashes of Xim's empire, the Thanium Worlds dissociated their history from the Tion Cluster. The Rimward portions of the Thanium Worlds in Xim's time, the [[Far Indrexu]], were integrated in the [[Indrexu Confederation]].<ref name="EAOC" />

While the Thanium Worlds survived as the name of a modern [[Sector/Legends|sector]], the millennia had remade these planets so utterly that they bore few traces of Xim's rule.<ref name="EAOC" />
